#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
unordered_map<ll, ll> memo;

ll rec(ll n) {
    if (memo.count(n)) return memo[n];
    if (n <= 11) {
        return memo[n] = min(n, 2 + (11 - n));
    }
    ll x = 1;
    int c = 1;
    while (n > x) {
        x = x * 10 + 1;
        c++;
    }
    ll part1 = (n / (x / 10)) * (c - 1) + rec(n % (x / 10));
    if (x > n * 2) {
        return memo[n] = part1;
    }
    return memo[n] = min(rec(x - n) + c, part1);
}

int main() {
    ll s;
    scanf("%lld", &s);
    printf("%lld\n", rec(s));
    return 0;
}
